exercises.title: 6. Pratique: Reporting verbs — show, indicate, suggest

items.prompt: The trend ___ that performance is improving.
The figures ___ that we should review the contract.
items.hintAfterError: 'The figures' é plural: o verbo não leva -s.

items.prompt: The audit report ___ three calculation errors.
Customer feedback ___ that we need faster responses.
items.hintAfterError: 'feedback' é incontável e funciona como singular.
